description: This file defines React functional components for UI elements related to asynchronous states, including error display, loading skeleton, and empty state components.

methods.name: InlineError
methods.description: A React functional component that renders an inline error message with optional details and an action button.

methods.name: SkeletonCard
methods.description: A React functional component that renders a placeholder skeleton card indicating loading state.

methods.name: EmptyState
methods.description: A React functional component that renders a generic empty state message with optional action and styled badge.
